description:
Destroy all Terraform-managed infrastructure in the workspace.

TWO-STEP SAFETY FLOW:
1. Call without confirmed=true → shows the destroy plan (what will be deleted).
2. Call with confirmed=true after the user explicitly approves → destroys everything.

This is irreversible. Always show the plan and get explicit user approval first.

confirmed.description: Must be true to actually destroy. Omit or false to preview only.

target.description: Limit operation to a specific resource address, e.g. aws_instance.web

vars.description: Variable overrides in key=value format, e.g. ["region=us-east-1"]

workdir.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory containing .tf files

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to use (default: current workspace)

name: tf_destroy
